name: Manchester Summer Day Camp
operator_name: Town of Manchester Leisure, Family and Recreation Department
description_short: A town run day camp for Manchester residents ages 5 to 13 who have finished kindergarten, 9 am to 3 pm in two week sessions. Campers are placed by age at Center Springs Park, the Leisure Labs at Mahoney, Buckley and Martin schools, or a teen site at Manchester Middle Academy, with daily pool time, field trips and lunch provided.
refund_policy_summary: Full refunds may be requested until June 8. No refunds after June 8.
swim_waterfront_notes: Campers swim at town pools: Marcy McDonald Pool, Swanson Pool, Salters Pool and Globe Hollow. Swim lessons during camp at Mahoney and Martin School cost extra.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Town summer camp page: six weeks, 9 am to 3 pm, $150 per two week session, lunch provided by Board of Education Food Services, field trip and special events schedule linked.

Researched by Claude from this page. 2026 pre-season flyer and FAQ. Open to children ages 5 to 15 who live in Manchester and have finished kindergarten; camp sites for ages 5 to 13 and a Recreation Leader in Training program for 14 and 15 year olds. Session 1 has no camp July 3. Before care 7:30 to 9 am and after care 3 to 5:30 pm, $60 a session each. The flyer gives one price ($150 a session), with no separate non-resident rate because camp is for residents only. No zip is given for the sites.
